digest.component_or_area: plan-review llm modules and module-size guards
propositions: Several high-centrality modules sit within a few lines of the 800-LOC module-size cap, blocking work that must touch them.
llm/config.py must be reduced to at or below 640 LOC by extracting into a new gate_context.py so ticket d23e can add a deprecation alias without structural change.
llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py must be reduced to at or below 560 LOC by splitting into decide_ops.py.
Each relieved file needs a seam test asserting a headroom target and every new module must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor.
A static test must assert full plan-review STEP_REGISTRY membership and that every uses: in gates/plan-review.yaml resolves, guards that do not exist today.
gen_env_registry.py --check must be clean and complete because _llm_float is invisible to the scanner, leaving env vars missing from docs/env-vars.md.
